========================================================================
 pyHanko Digital Signature Test Folder (samples/)
========================================================================

Place any PDF documents you want to inspect into this folder:
  - Digitally signed / e-signed PDFs (e.g. Adobe Sign, DocuSign, DSC, etc.)
  - Unsigned PDFs (standard documents, invoices, agreements)
  - Modified or tampered signed PDFs

The pyHanko Web Inspector and CLI will automatically detect and analyze
all files placed in this folder.

Quick Commands:
  - Run Web Inspector:  python app.py  (visit http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  - Run CLI Inspector:  python test_pyhanko.py
========================================================================
